recommendation: Keep the no-change audit as-is. Future GuidanceResponse work should follow later CDS decisions such as maturity/status updates or CDS Hooks IG alignment rather than reviving the superseded FHIR-13411 deprecation request.
issue_request: FHIR-13411 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 CDS change request asking to deprecate/remove GuidanceResponse and update Clinical Reasoning decision-support service guidance to reference CDS Hooks; its Jira comments state that the tracker was superseded by tracker 14179 and cite SVN 13353.
initial_application: The CDS Hooks documentation portion appears in source history as SVN r13353/git commit a3d51d2dfc (GF#14890), which updated Clinical Reasoning CDS-on-FHIR content to focus on CDS Hooks. The GuidanceResponse deprecation/removal portion was later reversed before the current build state.
additional_context: FHIR-14179 is a later Published/Persuasive same-artifact decision resolving to reverse GuidanceResponse deprecation and continue evolving the resource with CDS Hooks and CQI community input. Current source/fhir.ini keeps GuidanceResponse active, owned by CDS, FMM 4, approved, and patient-security scoped; the GuidanceResponse introduction and StructureDefinition describe active use cases and CDS Hooks interaction recording without deprecation language. FHIR-14179 is already represented on the combined branch by commit 1c7418010853f4f142e3693bcb82d4a7d7c4e1d4.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. Removing or deprecating GuidanceResponse would contradict the later same-artifact reversal, and adding CDS Hooks prose would be redundant with current source.
